title: French Bulldog Popularity Rose 1,000% As Lifespan Hit 4.5 Years
hook: French Bulldog registrations rose 1,000%, while lifespan stayed painfully short.
closing: Popularity should never replace a careful look at breed health.
question: What matters most when choosing dogs?

segments.say: The French Bulldog reached rank 1, ending the Labrador Retriever's lead.
French Bulldog registrations rose 1,000 percent, turning a niche breed into the favorite.
French Bulldog life expectancy was 4.5 years, far below the comparison breed.
